ValidationRule.description: Checks if the parent account is valid.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), NOT( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PMC_SS_Agent' ), NOT( ISBLANK( ParentId ) ), OR( AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Others')), OR( ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Ship-to'), ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Bill-to'), ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Payer'), Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PMC_SS_Agent', Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PMC_SS_Prospect' ) ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Ship-to'), ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Bill-to'), ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Payer'), ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Sold-to') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Sold-to')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Others' )) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Others'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Sold-to')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent.Type , 'Ship-to')) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Parent Account association is invalid, please add a valid Sold-to/Ship-to Account for Other Account or Sold-to/Other for a Sold-to Account as Parent Account.
